title: The Vault draws its Trophy case in the Frequency kit instead of nesting a DAWN card

source.ref: LIVE-938 area 4 (Vault) and the members-ui.css bridge cleanup

detail: The Frequency Vault body mounted DAWN's TrophyCase (components/quest/trophy-case.tsx), a bordered card of DAWN tiles, counters and caps labels that only fit the kit because members-ui.css repainted bordered DAWN cards. FqTrophyCase draws the same record (seasons newest first, each past season's stamped summary, a tile per finished Journey linking to it) in the kit's panel, card, ic and t1/t2 pieces. Rank hues stay data-driven through seasonRankStyle until the rank-colour ruling. DAWN's TrophyCase is unchanged for the DAWN build.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/frequency/members/vault/vault-body.tsx','utf8');if(s.includes('components/quest/trophy-case')||!s.includes('<FqTrophyCase ')){console.error('LIVE-1103: the Frequency Vault nests the DAWN Trophy case');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Frequency Vault goes back to DAWN's TrophyCase. Behavior is trophy-case.test.tsx.
